description: The bar chart illustrates ratio percentages for three category domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across three models indicated by color in the legend (Llama3 in blue, a second model in red, and ChatGPT in yellow). The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 90 with evenly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals (50, 60, 70, 80, 90). For Movies, the blue Llama3 bar reaches about 90%, the red bar is also about 90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 73%. For Songs, the blue bar is approximately 84%, the red bar is about 90%, and the yellow bar is near 62–63%. For Basketball, the blue bar is around 66–67%, the red bar is about 57–58%, and the yellow bar is about 61–62%. Bars are grouped by category with three adjacent bars per group (blue, red, yellow), there is no stacking, and the categories do not appear to be sorted by value; no bars are visually emphasized with annotations or special outlines beyond their distinct colors.
